summary: Masonglory Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 25, 2026 securities purchase agreement with four unaffiliated investors for a US$1.0 million private placement. The company sold 667,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$1.50/share, plus Series A warrants (166,750 shares at US$1.30) and Series B warrants (166,750 shares at US$1.10), each with two-year terms. Net proceeds will fund continued acquisition of equity interests in Austria's Beta Beteiligungs und Besitz GmbH; the company previously signed an August 12, 2026 share swap for 20%. Additional stake size and consideration remain under negotiation, with no definitive agreement yet. Watch for definitive deal terms, dilution from warrant overhang, and regulatory/valuation risk on the Austrian target.
